UNIT 12 · THEME-BASED CONVERSATION

Saying Thank You

用英語表達感謝

從朋友陪伴、職場協助、考前鼓勵到重要簡報，本單元學習如何依情境自然地表達感謝，以及如何回應別人的感謝。

上課流程

依「情境 → 會話 → 字詞句型 → 練習 → 統整」順序進行；可開啟專注模式。

目前階段：1. 暖身與情境
1 / 5
目前為「專注模式」：只顯示本階段需要的內容。點上方「顯示全部」可恢復完整頁面。

上課路線：本節目標：先讓學生知道四種感謝情境與本課任務。
看情境圖預測語句建立主題

四個日常情境，四種感謝深度。

分手後

I just wanted to say thanks for coming over last night.

幫助新進員工

I’m happy to help. Starting a new job can be difficult.

考試前的鼓勵

I can’t thank you enough for making those notes for me.

重要簡報之後

I don’t know what I would’ve done without you.

KEY EXPRESSIONS

表達感謝：不只 Thank you

上課路線：本節目標：先建立感謝與回應感謝的語用框架，再進會話。
感謝原因回應感謝強烈感謝反事實假設

依情境選擇語氣強度。

表達感謝原因

I’m grateful for N./V-ing.
我對……心懷感激。
Thanks so much for N./V-ing.
非常感謝你……。
I’m thankful that S. + V.
我很感謝……。
It meant a lot that S. + V.
……對我來說真的很重要。

回應對方的感謝

No problem.
沒問題；不客氣。
Of course.
當然，我很樂意幫忙。
You’re welcome.
不客氣。
Don’t mention it.
別客氣；不用放在心上。
It was nothing.
沒什麼；小事而已。

強烈感謝

can’t V ... enough

字面意思是「怎麼……都不夠」，用來強調程度很高。can’t thank you enough =「再怎麼感謝你都不夠」→「非常感謝你」。

假設過去沒有對方幫忙

would / could / might have + p.p.

用來表示對過去情況的假設，通常實際情況並非如此。

I don’t know how I would’ve managed without you.
I couldn’t have done it without you.

DIALOGUE 1

After a Breakup

上課路線：會話 1：友情支持。先理解情境，再逐句點字與片語。
看情境朗讀原文點字補充句型整理

Ron is thanking Julie for her support.

點任一英文單字：字義＋詞性＋本句功能藍色字：高中／學測延伸重點粉色底線：教材核心片語／字詞
FRIENDSHIP

分手後的陪伴與感謝

重點：thanks for V-ing / have a hard time / be there for sb / could use sth

R
Hey, I just wanted to say thanks for coming over last night.
教學中譯：嘿，我只是想謝謝你昨晚過來陪我。
thanks for + N./V-ing：感謝某件事／某個動作。
J
Of course. I knew you were having a hard time after the breakup.
教學中譯：當然。我知道你分手後過得很不好。
have a hard time + V-ing 也可表示「做某事很吃力」。
R
I really needed someone to talk to, and you just sat there and listened for hours. You even brought dinner over—I hadn’t eaten all day.
教學中譯：我真的很需要有人聊聊，你就坐在那裡聽了我好幾個小時。你甚至還帶晚餐過來——我一整天都沒吃東西。
J
You’ve helped me out so many times. I wanted to do the same for you.
教學中譯：你也幫過我很多次。我只是想為你做同樣的事。
do the same for sb：為某人做同樣的事。
R
I really appreciate you being there for me. Honestly, you made a terrible night feel a little better.
教學中譯：我真的很感激你陪在我身邊支持我。老實說，你讓一個糟糕的夜晚好過了一點。
appreciate + N./V-ing；此處 you being there 是動名詞片語。
J
Anytime. And tonight, we’re watching something funny. No sad movies allowed.
教學中譯：隨時都可以。今晚我們要看點好笑的，不准看悲傷電影。
R
Deal. I could really use a laugh.
教學中譯：說定了。我真的很需要笑一笑。
could use + N. 是自然口語，不是「可以使用」的字面義。
DIALOGUE 2

Helping a New Employee

上課路線：會話 2：職場協助。聚焦禮貌、適應新環境與職場用語。
情境導入逐句理解字詞搭配重點句型

Lucia is talking to Daniel in the office.

WORKPLACE

幫助新進員工

重點：thank sb for V-ing / internal / settle in / grateful for

L
Daniel, do you have a minute?
教學中譯：Daniel，你有空一下嗎？
Do you have a minute? 是禮貌地請對方給一點時間。
D
Sure. Is everything all right?
教學中譯：當然。都還好嗎？
L
Yes. I just wanted to thank you for helping me these past few weeks.
教學中譯：是的。我只是想謝謝你這幾週一直幫我。
thank sb for + N./V-ing。
D
I’m happy to help. Starting a new job can be difficult.
教學中譯：我很樂意幫忙。開始一份新工作可能不容易。
V-ing 當主詞：Starting a new job ...
L
You showed me how to use the internal system and explained how our online meetings work.
教學中譯：你教我怎麼使用公司內部系統，也解釋了線上會議如何運作。
show sb how to V；explain how + S + V。
D
I remember having all the same questions when I started.
教學中譯：我記得我剛開始時也有完全一樣的問題。
remember + V-ing：記得做過某事。
L
I’m very grateful for all your patience. You made it much easier for me to settle in.
教學中譯：我非常感謝你的耐心。你讓我更容易適應這裡。
make it + Adj. + for sb + to V：使某人做某事變得……。
D
You learned very quickly! I think you’ll be more than OK.
教學中譯：你學得很快！我覺得你不只會沒問題，你會做得很好。
more than OK 帶有安慰與鼓勵語氣。
DIALOGUE 3

Encouragement Before an Exam

上課路線：會話 3：考前鼓勵。聚焦 can’t ... enough 與學習相關片語。
情境導入逐句理解學測搭配口語應用

Clara and Nicholas are getting ready for an exam.

STUDY

考試前的鼓勵

重點：can’t thank you enough / go over / give up / keep going

C
I still can’t believe the exam is tomorrow.
教學中譯：我還是不敢相信考試就是明天。
N
You’ll be fine. You know more than you think.
教學中譯：你會沒事的。你知道的比你自己以為的還多。
more than + 子句：比……更多。
C
Only because you helped me study. I can’t thank you enough for making those notes for me.
教學中譯：那只是因為你幫我讀書。我真的非常感謝你幫我整理那些筆記。
can’t + V + enough：怎麼……都不夠，強調程度很高。
N
No problem. I knew you had a lot of other work to do.
教學中譯：不客氣。我知道你還有很多其他事情要做。
C
And you patiently spent two hours going over the hardest part with me.
教學中譯：而且你還很有耐心地花兩小時和我一起複習最難的部分。
spend + 時間 + V-ing。
N
Well, that part was confusing; it was good practice for us both.
教學中譯：嗯，那部分確實很容易讓人困惑；對我們兩個都是很好的練習。
C
I was ready to give up, honestly.
教學中譯：老實說，我那時都準備要放棄了。
be ready to V；give up 放棄。
N
But you didn’t. You kept going.
教學中譯：但你沒有。你繼續撐下去了。
keep + V-ing：持續做……。
C
Well, I feel much better now.
教學中譯：嗯，我現在感覺好多了。
N
Good. Just remember to get enough sleep tonight.
教學中譯：很好。記得今晚要睡飽。
remember to V：記得要做某事。
DIALOGUE 4

After a Big Presentation

上課路線：會話 4：簡報後感謝。聚焦 would have + p.p. 與簡報字彙。
情境導入逐句理解假設語氣簡報語彙

Stephanie praises Adam after a presentation.

PRESENTATION

重要簡報之後

重點：nervous / calm down / slide / would have + p.p.

A
Stephanie, I wanted to thank you for your help this week.
教學中譯：Stephanie，我想謝謝你這週的幫忙。
S
You prepared so well. I knew you could do it.
教學中譯：你準備得很好。我就知道你做得到。
A
I just didn’t want to make any mistakes. It was my first presentation in this company.
教學中譯：我只是不想犯任何錯。這是我在這間公司的第一次正式簡報。
S
Everyone gets nervous before presenting. But you still knew the material better than anyone.
教學中譯：每個人在上台簡報前都會緊張。但你還是比任何人都熟悉內容。
better than anyone 是比較級表達最高程度的常見方式。
A
Your support all week let me focus and calm down. You checked the slides and helped me practice so many times. I don’t know what I would’ve done without you.
教學中譯：你這一整週的支持讓我能專心並冷靜下來。你幫我檢查投影片，還陪我練習了很多次。我真不知道沒有你我會怎麼辦。
let + O + V；would have + p.p. 對過去反事實情況的假設。
S
You’re very welcome. I’m glad I was able to help out.
教學中譯：真的不客氣。我很高興我能幫上忙。
VOCABULARY

核心字彙

上課路線：單字統整：用圖片先建立語意，再翻卡看教材例句。
看圖猜字字義詞性教材例句大考字彙

點卡片翻面，複習教材字義與例句。

字彙小筆記

breakup

breakup n. 分手。這是教材列出的補充字。常見搭配：after a breakup、go through a breakup。動詞片語則寫成 break up。

INFO BOX

重要片語與補充

上課路線：片語統整：將四段會話出現的 Info Box 一次歸納。
片語義介系詞語用易錯點

教材 Info Box 直接整理成可應考搭配。

come over順道來訪；過來坐坐。此處不及物。
have a hard time過得很艱難；have a hard time + V-ing 做某事很吃力。
help (sb) out幫（某人）忙，可及物或不及物。
be there for sb給予某人協助、慰藉、支持。
could use sth口語：需要……；想要……。
go over sth複習……；仔細檢查……。
slide此處為可數名詞，指簡報投影片。
GRAMMAR & USAGE

高中／學測重點整理

上課路線：文法統整：只整理本單元真正需要的高中／學測句型。
感謝句型程度強調反事實過去V-ing / to V

由教材句型延伸，不改動原文。

thank / appreciate / be grateful
thank sb for + N./V-ing

I wanted to thank you for helping me.

appreciate + N./V-ing

I appreciate you being there for me.

be grateful for + N./V-ing

I’m grateful for all your patience.

can’t + V + enough

表示「再怎麼……都不夠」，用來強調程度很高。

I can’t thank you enough. = 我真的非常感謝你。

延伸：I can’t stress this enough. = 這件事我再怎麼強調都不為過。

would / could / might have + p.p.

對過去未實現情況的假設，常與 without / if 等語意搭配。

I don’t know what I would’ve done without you.

I couldn’t have done it without you.

remember + V-ing

記得做過某事：I remember having the same questions.

remember + to V

記得要做某事：Remember to get enough sleep.

spend + time + V-ing

spent two hours going over the hardest part

互動練習

即時檢查理解與語用。

1. Which response is most natural after someone thanks you for helping them?

2. Which sentence means “我真的非常感謝你幫我整理那些筆記”?

3. “I don’t know what I would’ve done without you” mainly expresses ______.

4. Which phrase means “複習；仔細檢查”?
